problem.problem:
Bob is not round. Charlie is furry. Charlie is nice. Charlie is smart. Erin is red. Fiona is furry. Fiona is young. All red people are not round. Red people are not blue. All young people are furry. If Erin is red and Erin is not round then Erin is nice. If someone is round and nice then they are not young. All smart people are young. Nice people are smart.

Determine whether the following statement is true, false, or unknown:
Erin is not furry.

Predicates:
Round($x, bool) ::: Is x round?
Furry($x, bool) ::: Is x furry?
Nice($x, bool) ::: Is x nice?
Smart($x, bool) ::: Is x smart?
Red($x, bool) ::: Is x red?
Blue($x, bool) ::: Is x blue?
Young($x, bool) ::: Is x young?

Facts:
Round(Bob, False) ::: Bob is not round.
Furry(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is furry.
Nice(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is nice.
Smart(Charlie, True) ::: Charlie is smart.
Red(Erin, True) ::: Erin is red.
Furry(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is furry.
Young(Fiona, True) ::: Fiona is young.

Rules:
Red($x, True) >>> Round($x, False) ::: All red people are not round.
Red($x, True) >>> Blue($x, False) ::: Red people are not blue.
Young($x, True) >>> Furry($x, True) ::: All young people are furry.
Red(Erin, True) && Round(Erin, False) >>> Nice(Erin, True) ::: If Erin is red and Erin is not round then Erin is nice.
Round($x, True) && Nice($x, True) >>> Young($x, False) ::: If someone is round and nice then they are not young.
Smart($x, True) >>> Young($x, True) ::: All smart people are young.
Nice($x, True) >>> Smart($x, True) ::: Nice people are smart.

Query:
Furry(Erin, False) ::: Erin is not furry.
